message: Operation 'cancelTransfer' has semantic quality issues: missing_context, missing_side_effects. Summary is clear and actionable. Description is incomplete - it doesn't specify which statuses are cancellable vs. non-cancellable, doesn't explain the side effect of releasing held funds, and doesn't clarify the irreversibility or idempotency behavior. Enhanced description provides all necessary context for AI agents to understand when cancellation is possible, what happens to funds, and how to handle edge cases.

data.current_description: Cancel a pending transfer before it executes.
data.description_suggestion: Cancel a transfer that is still in a cancellable state (CREATED or PENDING). Releases any held funds in Midaz and sets the transfer status to CANCELLED. Cannot cancel transfers already submitted to external systems (PROCESSING status) or in terminal states (COMPLETED, REJECTED, FAILED, CANCELLED). Cancellation cannot be reversed. Idempotent - calling cancel on an already-cancelled transfer returns success. Use this to abort transfers before they are irreversibly submitted to external systems.
